subject: Supply validation for PO acceptance & VAT reverse-charge guidance
message_1_subject: Lumina vendor registration & PO mapping questions
message_1_body:
Hi Sofía,

We're preparing vendor registration for Redwood so we can start sending POs and paying for the Dedicated capacity pilot. Two quick asks from our AP team before we create the vendor record: 

1) PO mapping: can you confirm which fields you require on the buyer PO so our system maps line items correctly? They asked specifically about: buyer PO number placement, 'line item description' vs 'service code', and a mandatory product code field.

2) VAT treatment: for invoices billed to Lumina Health (Italy) many of our purchases fall under reverse-charge (art. 7-ter / B2B services). Do you have an EU VAT ID or will Redwood issue invoices with 0% VAT plus the required reverse-charge text? If you need to provide a VAT self-cert or any EU tax evidence, please attach.

Also please share your preferred remit (bank details or payment portal) and whether you accept e-invoices via our vendor portal (we can do a test e-invoice). I've attached our PO template for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Procurement Lead — Lumina Health
elena.rossi@luminahealth.it
Attachment: Lumina_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)
message_2_subject: Re: Lumina vendor registration & PO mapping questions
message_2_body:
Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the PO template.

Quick answers up front: we can support the mappings you listed but need a couple of required fields on every invoice to ensure PO matching and automated payment: 

- Buyer PO number: must appear in the invoice header (not only in line items).
- Invoice number: unique, numeric/alphanumeric, placed in header.
- Invoice date & due date.
- Line item SKU: for Redwood please use one of the following product codes on the PO/line item so our AP can map automatically: API_USAGE, DEDICATED_POOL, OPTIMIZE_SERVICE.
- Currency: EUR is fine for Lumina.

VAT / reverse charge: Redwood Inference (US entity) is not registered for VAT in Italy. For B2B services where reverse charge applies we typically: 

- Issue the invoice with no VAT (0%) and include the EU reverse-charge statement on the invoice: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 7-ter"
- Provide a completed VAT self-cert (we've attached a template) that you can store in your vendor record.

If Lumina requires a local VAT-registered invoice (or self-billing), let us know and we can escalate to Finance to discuss local compliance options.

Attached: 
- REDWOOD_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf — our full vendor onboarding checklist and required fields (legal name, registered address, tax IDs, remit details, invoicing samples).
- VAT_SelfCert_Template.pdf — fillable template for EU VAT evidence.
- Banking_Remittance_Template.csv — the exact remittance fields our payments team will import.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Lumina creates the vendor record using the legal name exactly as in the attached onboarding packet.
2) Upload the VAT self-cert + remit CSV to your portal and mark the vendor as e-invoice enabled.
3) Lumina sends a test e-invoice (PO: 23890) and we will confirm mapping.

If helpful I can schedule a 20-min call with AP and your vendor-portal team. We can also sign a short data-transfer attestation via DocuSign if required.

Best,
Sofía Ivanova
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference
Attachment: REDWOOD_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (application/pdf); VAT_SelfCert_Template.pdf (application/pdf); Banking_Remittance_Template.csv (text/csv)
message_3_subject: Re: Lumina vendor registration & PO mapping questions
message_3_body:
Sofía — perfect, thanks for the clear checklist. A couple follow-ups from our side: 

- Confirmed: Lumina will accept invoices with 0% VAT where reverse charge applies and will account for VAT on our side. Please ensure the line on the invoice reads exactly: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 7-ter".
- We will create the vendor record today and upload your VAT self-cert.
- For the pilot: we will generate PO 23890 and do a single test e-invoice. Please send a sample invoice header (PDF) so our portal mapping team can verify the header fields.

One more question: our approvals workflow includes a 2-step match (PO + invoice). If an invoice is received without the exact SKU mapping, it goes to manual review and payment is delayed. Can your billing team include product codes on the invoice lines?

Thanks,
Marco
Vendor Onboarding — Lumina Health
Attachment: none
